precision: Iris BF16 parameters and network autocast on RTX5070, FP32 integrator, cuDNN SDPA on unmasked trunk/PiT, standard masked SDPA on text refiner; VLM and receiver text language stack FP16 on V100
communication: UTF8 JSON packet containing prompt, seed, resolution and immutable decoder protocol id. Model revisions are shared protocol assets; no image or image-conditioned hidden states at receiver.
evaluation: CLIP image cosine, DINOv2 image cosine, PSNR and MAE separately; visual review of counts, shape, color and layout. Average seeds within each image before paired image bootstrap. Synthetic controls excluded from photo aggregate.
limitations: Exploratory 11-photo cohort; known examples and unknown training overlap. Native 1024px sampling at 10 steps is below the official 100-step recommendation; 40-step check on three predefined photos only. Outputs downsampled to 256px for matching sources and feature pilot. Word targets requested rather than edited; actual bytes recorded. Initial feature-head diagnostic uses a different decoder, compute and byte budget.
